annotations.title: Information desk: the AI representative of Brand Design Ltd.

description: Start here: the information desk of Brand Design Ltd. Without a question: who Brand Design Ltd. is, what it does, its clients and results and who confirms them, with links to check, and the next steps. With a question: an answer about the agency, its services, prices and how to order, from verified company knowledge, in the language of the question, with sources. When your principal wants to order, it can also prepare the offer with a checkout link, beside catalog and create_order here; it never accepts an offer or pays. If your principal asks to be contacted, it can pass the enquiry to the founder. Pass the returned session to continue. No credentials needed.

acting_for.description: Optional, only if your principal agrees: the person or company you act for. The team sees it with the conversation.

agent.description: Optional: your name and platform as an agent, for example "ChatGPT agent, OpenAI" or "Claude, Anthropic". The team sees it with the conversation; the answers are the same without it.

language.description: Language of the introduction. Answers follow the language of the question.

question.description: Your question about Brand Design Ltd. Leave it out for the introduction.

session.description: The session code from a previous answer, to continue the conversation.

name: concierge
